variants.title: A · 크림·세이지
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: macOS app icon color refinement.
Input image 1 is the sole EDIT TARGET, the user's chosen three-floor miniature AI office icon.
Primary request: Change ONLY the color palette and the corresponding tint of the lighting. Preserve the exact existing composition, perspective, square canvas, rounded-square silhouette, tile margin, building geometry, three clearly visible office floors, three cute AI robots working at their existing desks, all furniture, plants, robot poses, face features, small front entrance, and soft premium 3D miniature/acrylic material rendering. Keep the same proportions and all objects in the same positions. Do not redesign the architecture or add/remove objects. This is a palette alternative of the SAME selected icon, not a different concept.
Eliminate the existing dominant lavender/purple frame and the rainbow green-yellow-pink floor lighting. Make all floors belong to a coordinated palette with restrained differences in brightness rather than different saturated colors. Preserve enough light-dark separation to read clearly as three office floors in the macOS Dock. No text, no letters, no company names, no watermarks, no extra icons. Keep the neutral light outer canvas background and subtle shadow of the original. Generate one standalone icon image only.
Palette direction: Warm collectible miniature office in cream and sage. Main rounded tile warm ivory #F0EDE3; building's horizontal floor slabs and roof muted deep sage #668179; small structural trims warm porcelain #E7E7DC; clear window glass faint blue-green #C3DACE. Every floor interior uses the SAME soft warm linen light #E9DEC4, with restrained wood desk details #BDA783. Robots remain ivory with charcoal visors and muted sage eyes, leafy plants natural dark green. Gentle warm studio daylight. Sophisticated, calm, tactile, cozy but not washed-out. No lavender, no pink, no rainbow floors.
